title: Retailer routing-guide rule discovery — first pass
status: Discovery inventory; illustrative rule families and examples, not an exhaustive extraction or an executable compliance ruleset.
scope_notes: Ten PDFs retrieved as connector text from the four requested folders. Six DOCX/XLSX supporting files were catalogued but not read.
Raw-file URLs returned HTTP 403; page diagrams, visual tables and extraction completeness have not been verified.
Printed page references come from extracted text, not PDF page indices. Source text line references provide stable local anchors.
Retailer portal currency was not verified. Upload dates are not document effective dates.
The Nordstrom Compliance Master identifies itself as 2002 and is excluded from current operational examples.
Michaels lacks the referenced VendorConnect pre-shipment/label manual; its 850 guide is non-merchandise only.
Walmart file is the Secondary Packaging section with printed pages 177–406 plus a cover, not the full 406-page standards collection or separate Shipping and Routing guide.
source_tools: google_drive_fetch (folder listings, metadata and readable text; raw download attempted)

rule_shapes: numeric bound with unit and measurement basis
representation_requirements: Keep raw wording and normative force alongside interpretation.
Store applicability separately from requirement: retailer, channel/network, destination, department, PO type, freight terms, carrier/mode, product attributes and dates.
Preserve physical nesting and relationships: shipment, delivery, PO, pallet, master carton, carton, inner pack and item.
Keep identifier strings, application identifiers and barcode symbology distinct; retain leading zeros.
Represent conditions with AND/OR, units, comparison operators, deadlines and explicit exceptions; unresolved boundary cases stay unresolved.
Link an exception to the specific rule it changes; do not assume later upload wins.
Record data needed to evaluate each rule, human/visual evidence requirements, and missing-information states.
Keep fees and consequences separate from requirements and from guarantees of enforcement.

examples.anchor: For consolidated shipments Nordstrom requires

evidence.excerpt:
For consolidated shipments Nordstrom requires that there is one VICS 856 ASN with carton level information per shipment, per 
ship-to location (distribution center), and each ship notice must contain its own unique sub-bill of lading number. Nordstrom also 
requires that the ASN is transmitted and received by Nordstrom’s warehouse management system prior to the shipment’s arrival in 
the distribution center. A chargeback will be applied if this requirement is not met. 
UPS ASN Requirements
For shipments sent via UPS, Nordstrom requires that there is one ASN transmitted per case and the tracking number provided by 
UPS must populate the sub-bill of lading field (REF*BM segment) and the PRO number field (REF*CN segment). Nordstrom also 
requires that the ASN is transmitted and received by Nordstrom’s warehouse management system prior to the shipment’s arrival in 
the distribution center.
Bulk Pack ASN
If asked to bulk pack a PO by receiving a code of "BULK" in the REF*QC segment, the 856/ASN should contain the DC number in 
both the ship-to (N1*ST) and mark-for (N1*BY) segments.

evidence.excerpt:
ASN data can be retransmitted to Nordstrom at any time prior to the shipment’s arrival in the distribution center. When retransmitting 
data, please be sure to update the BSN01 to ‘07’ for duplicate/replacement.
Also, to ensure correct retransmission, the new or corrected ASN must maintain the same sub-bill of lading value PO/DC 
combination as the original. This is the value sent in the REF/BM. This will allow the “new” ASN to overwrite the original ASN in our 
warehouse management system. If the ‘new‘ data reaches our warehouse management system before the warehouse personnel 
begin to process the shipment and all other information within the transmission is accurate, no charge backs should be incurred. 
However, if the shipment arrives before the “new” ASN is received then the shipment will be received with the original ASN data. 
Please note, to avoid duplication errors, we advise waiting 60 minutes before re-transmitting the correct EDI 856.
997/Functional Acknowledgments
Nordstrom sends a 997 (functional acknowledgment) back within 24 hours for any inbound file we receive. Please be aware a 997 
indicates receipt of a file only. A 997 does not indicate the data was processed through Nordstrom’s warehouse management system 
successfully. To ensure Nordstrom is receiving any 856 files from your company, please be sure to monitor your 997’s.

evidence.excerpt:
If Walmart identifies specific data issues in the ASN, an 824 (Application Advice) will be issued. Suppliers must be set up to detect when an 824 is received and be prepared 
to review and resolve the issues it identifies.
4. Correction and Retransmission:
Once issues from the 824 are addressed, the supplier must correct the ASN and retransmit it. This restarts the validation cycle:
• Wait for a new 997 response
• Check for any new 824 messages
5. Compliance Impact:
If the ASN is not corrected and retransmitted before the freight arrives at the Walmart receiving facility, the supplier’s ASN compliance will be negatively affected.
6. Successful Transmission:
If no 824 is received after a 997 acknowledgment, the supplier can be reasonably confident that the ASN was successfully processed.
